name: Morishita Suzu
source:
Single daughter of a director of a large hospital. Because of getting sick on the day of college entrance examinations, she was forced to become a college dropout. A reserved girl who doesn't open her heart to anyone except Ryouji.

Is it impossible to make her laugh?


[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050507113120/http://210.166.209.38:80/html/soft/flove/chara_b.htm]website[/url]]
